context: Meeting new people at a party

dialogue.speaker: Stranger
dialogue.text: Hi! I don't think we've met. I'm Sarah.
dialogue.text_uz: Salom! O'ylaymanki, biz tanishmaganmiz. Men Sarah.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: Nice to meet you, Sarah! I'm Alex. How do you know the host?
dialogue.answer_uz: Tanishganimdan xursandman, Sarah! Men Alex. Uy egasini qanday taniysan?
options: Nice to meet you, Sarah! I'm Alex. How do you know the host?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I really like your jacket! Where did you get it?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.answer: Thank you so much! I found it at a vintage shop downtown.
dialogue.answer_uz: Katta rahmat! Shahar markazidagi vintage do'kondan topdim.
options: Thank you so much! I found it at a vintage shop downtown.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: We're having a barbecue this Saturday. Would you like to come?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.answer: I'd love to! What time should I come, and can I bring anything?
dialogue.answer_uz: Juda xursand bo'lardim! Soat nechada kelaman va biror narsa olib kelsam bo'ladimi?
options: I'd love to! What time should I come, and can I bring anything?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'm so sorry I'm late! Traffic was terrible.
dialogue.text_uz: Kechikkanim uchun uzr! Tirbandlik juda katta edi.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.answer: No worries at all! I just got here myself. Let's grab a table.
dialogue.answer_uz: Hech gap yo'q! Men ham hozirgina keldim. Stol egallaymiz.
options: No worries at all! I just got here myself. Let's grab a table.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.text: Are you free this weekend? We should do something fun!
dialogue.text_uz: Dam olish kunlari bandmisan? Qiziqarli narsa qilaylik!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: Yes, I'm free on Sunday! How about we go hiking or catch a movie?
dialogue.answer_uz: Ha, yakshanba kuni bo'shman! Sayrga chiqsak yoki kino ko'rsak-chi?
options: Yes, I'm free on Sunday! How about we go hiking or catch a movie?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I heard you got promoted! Congratulations!

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.answer: Thank you so much! It's been a lot of hard work, but I'm really excited.
dialogue.answer_uz: Katta rahmat! Ko'p mehnat bo'ldi, lekin juda xursandman.
options: Thank you so much! It's been a lot of hard work, but I'm really excited.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: You look like you have your hands full. Can I help you carry something?
dialogue.text_uz: Qo'lingiz to'la ko'rinadi. Biror narsa ko'tarishga yordam beraymi?

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.answer: That would be wonderful! Could you grab those grocery bags?
dialogue.answer_uz: Bu juda yaxshi bo'lardi! O'sha oziq-ovqat sumkalarini ko'tarib yuborsangiz?
options: That would be wonderful! Could you grab those grocery bags?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: Are you leaving already? It was so nice having you!
dialogue.text_uz: Allaqachon ketyapsizmi? Sizni ko'rib juda yaxshi bo'ldi!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: Yes, I have an early morning. Thank you for the wonderful evening!
dialogue.answer_uz: Ha, ertaga erta turaman. Ajoyib kechki taom uchun rahmat!
options: Yes, I have an early morning. Thank you for the wonderful evening!

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.text: I think we see this differently. Can we talk about it?
dialogue.text_uz: O'ylaymanki, biz buni boshqacha ko'ramiz. Bu haqda gaplashsak bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: Of course. I value our friendship, and I want to understand your perspective.
dialogue.answer_uz: Albatta. Men do'stligimizni qadrlayman va sizning fikringizni tushunmoqchiman.
options: Of course. I value our friendship, and I want to understand your perspective.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.text: My grandmother passed away last week.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: I'm so sorry for your loss. Is there anything I can do to help?
dialogue.answer_uz: Yo'qotishingiz uchun juda afsusdaman. Yordam bera oladigan biror narsam bormi?
options: I'm so sorry for your loss. Is there anything I can do to help?
